meta_description:
422 likes, 3 comments - hansajiyogendra on October 14, 2026: "When the mind is restless, forcing it to become calm often creates even more resistance.

Instead of fighting every thought, begin with something simpler  your breath.
Slow it down.

Make it steady.
Notice it without rushing.

To steady a restless mind, do not fight it. First steady the breath the mind will follow on its own.”
The breath and mind are deeply connected. When breathing becomes calmer and more rhythmic, the mind often begins to settle too.

So the next time your thoughts feel scattered, don’t argue with them.
Come back to your breath. 

#theyogainstitute #drhhansaji #bhakti #gratitude".
